messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: ENG_ONCALL - dispatcher-queue (redwood-prod-us-west-2) backlog > 8k, queue processing lagging, autoscaler not provisioning. https://p.d/PD-INC-4387

pagerduty: page fired -> ENG_ONCALL (high)

mira: acked. I'm on rotation, jumping in. seeing queue_length=8214, avg-consume-rate=120/s, inbound=450/s. autoscaler events show repeated 'provision accepted' but nodes not registering in cluster.

sahil: also getting many 429s from cloud provider create-node API in the last 2m: "rateLimitExceeded". this looks like provider throttling.

kai: @mira can you check autoscaler logs and k8s events? I'll try a manual spin-up of a pre-warmed node if we need immediate capacity.

mira: grabbing logs now. tail from autoscaler: ```
E0317 12:14:05 autoscaler.go:233] provision request id=pr-9842 failed: api error: status=429 details="rateLimitExceeded: calls to CreateInstances exceeded per-minute threshold"
E0317 12:14:08 autoscaler.go:239] retrying; backoff 2s
E0317 12:14:30 autoscaler.go:233] provision request id=pr-9843 accepted by cloud (request-id xxxxx) but node did not register within 30s
```

mira: kube-apiserver shows spikes in 429s too, probable provider-side throttling causing create -> register window to exceed healthchecks.

ops-bot: deploy-bot detected autoscaler pod restart at 12:12:47 (rolling back?). no recent deploys from eng-runtime.

kai: manual action: I started a pre-provisioned instance in the pool (using infra console warmup) — should show in ~90s. If that doesn't land, we'll try manual node create via cloud console.

sahil: recommending temporary mitigation: 1) reduce max-concurrency to lower inbound processing pressure (apply per-route throttle), 2) enable fallback to smaller model to reduce per-request tokens, 3) manual scale nodepool by +6 if possible.

mira: applying throttle rule to public route now: `rb config set-rate-limit --route /v1/generate --rps 300`

mira: enabling fallback route to quantized model: `rb routing set-fallback --model redwood-q4f --weight 0.3`

kai: manual node create returned 403 initially (quota check), worked on 2nd attempt after bumping pool quota via infra console. new nodes registering: 3 -> ready.

sahil: autoscaler pods still logging 429s, but with 3 manual nodes the queue drain rate jumped to ~420/s. backlog now 6150. still degraded but trending down.

mira: restarting autoscaler to clear possible stuck requests: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler`

ops-bot: autoscaler restart initiated by mira.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ENG_ONCALL acknowledged by mira, responders: mira, sahil, kai.

mira: quick customer-impact note: some interactive customers reporting 5-10s extra latency and occasional 503s for heavy batch jobs. no complete outage. Shipping teams notified.

sahil: raise PD escalation if backlog > 10k or if error rate (5xx) > 2% sustained for 5m. Otherwise continue mitigation.

kai: after manual nodes + routing changes, queue drain improved: 420/s, inbound 300/s, backlog 4820. still monitoring.

mira: triggered PD incident status update: mitigation in progress, impact: degraded latency & intermittent 5xx for heavy requests, mitigation: manual scale + throttling + fallback routing applied.

sahil: assigning post-incident action: investigate autoscaler retry/backoff strategy vs provider rate limits, add provider-side rate-limit detector to avoid stampeding, add capability to pre-warm nodes when we detect provider 429s.

mira: handing over to sahil for overnight on-call. I'll create an incident ticket with logs and the sequence of actions. @sahil you're on the hook for follow-ups.

sahil: taking over. will monitor for 30m, will escalate to infra if we see further throttling. opening JIRA: RED-INC-4387.

kai: leaving note: possible root cause = provider-side create-instance throttling combined with high churn from eviction policy during drain window. recommend temporary reducing eviction aggressiveness on busy cell.

mira: agreed. next steps in ticket: (1) tune eviction/drain timings, (2) expose cloud API rate-limit metrics to dashboards, (3) autoscaler backoff policy refinement.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ENG_ONCALL incident status -> acknowledged -> assigned to sahil.

sahil: marking thread resolved for now; queue at 2980 and steady. will re-open if metrics regress.

mira: thanks team. adding summary to postmortems channel later.
